examples.scenario: A bow-tie parcel polygon self-intersects near a raster cell edge
examples.reason: Sampling an invalid surface can produce an incorrect intersection and unstable extrema.

examples.scenario: MakeValid converts one polygon into two polygon components
examples.reason: Selecting only the largest component would silently change parcel coverage.

examples.scenario: A narrow parcel sliver collapses to a LineString at the declared precision
examples.reason: A lower-dimensional result cannot represent the parcel area for raster statistics.

examples.scenario: Naïve decimal rounding creates a ring self-intersection
examples.reason: Coordinate rounding without topology repair can create invalid geometry.
The failure must remain explicit and any robust retry must use a justified precision model.

examples.scenario: Two individually valid repaired parcels overlap by 0.4 square metres
examples.reason: Feature validity does not detect inter-feature overlaps.

examples.scenario: Neighboring parcels have a sub-threshold gap after repair
examples.reason: Gap acceptance depends on an explicit unit-bound threshold, not visual inspection.

examples.scenario: Repair closes an interior courtyard hole
examples.reason: The changed footprint can admit raster cells that were legally outside the parcel surface.
